methodology: MANUAL SAME-DAY RERUN following initial 11/78 verified audit. All 78 categories received independently logged URL attempts via source-probes/2026-11-04.json, with 61 HTTP success and 17 HTTP failures; each category was separately reconsidered using official issuer pages, IR news, events, filings and indexed primary-source pages. Only categories with specific issuer evidence are 'verified'; mere HTTP success does not qualify. Inaccessible or sparse sources remain INCOMPLETE, never interpreted as no changes. Current seven-day review period October 28-November 4. No exhaustive 78/78 claim.
